_doc: #1708 the loader the pinned proot (proot.json beside this file) embeds, pinned by sha256 per ABI: the bytes between proot's own symbols _binary_loader_exe_start and _binary_loader_exe_end, which carve-proot-loader.py writes out as a file of its own and refuses unless they hash to the value here. Both terminals ship proot AND that loader as native libraries (libcloudproot.so, libcloudprootloader.so under jniLibs) and point PROOT_LOADER at the latter: from targetSdk 29 an app may not execve() a file in its data directory, which is where proot would otherwise extract the loader before exec'ing it for every guest program. Same proot, same loader, another directory. A file of its own, NOT a key of proot.json: proot.json is one of the nix rootfs library's identity files (ac_cloud-nix-on-droid/build.json), and the loader changes nothing in that library's bytes. When proot.json's pin moves, re-run carve-proot-loader.py (it prints the new digest in its FAIL line) and update the value here in the same commit.
